about.title: About

seo.description: About Gabriele Cabrini: fullstack developer working across Java and Angular business software, Linux infrastructure and open source. Contacts and profiles.

about.bio:
I'm Gabriele, a fullstack developer. I mostly work on business software and enterprise applications: Java, Spring Boot and Kotlin on the backend, Angular on the frontend, and whatever it takes for the two to work well together.
I like following a project from start to finish, deploy included: I've used Linux for years and I'm happy to deal with containers, Kubernetes and servers. Outside work, I also contribute to a few open source projects.

skyblockpuro.description: Founder and technical lead of a multiplayer game server (Minecraft): network infrastructure with proxies and DDoS protection, custom Java plugin development, platform version upgrades and coordination of external contributors.

r1se-gaming.description: Built Java bots and tools for the company's communities and helped on other projects.

sandrini-metalli.description: Develop the company ERP and MES (Spring Boot and Angular) and a companion Android app in Flutter. Manage CI/CD pipelines and the SQL Server database; hands-on experience with Docker (Swarm), Kubernetes and VMware.

metamc-networks.description: Developed Java plugins for a multiplayer game platform (Minecraft) with 150+ concurrent users and managed the server infrastructure.

devroom.description: Commissioned work for the DevRoom team: mods, server configurations and custom plugins.

runtopage.title: runto.page
runtopage.description: Free URL shortener with custom links (runto.page/menu) instead of random strings. Destinations can be changed any time, every link gets its own QR code and everything can also be managed through a REST API.

servo.title: Servo
servo.description: Web rendering engine written in Rust, designed to be embedded in other applications through a WebView API. It builds on Rust's memory safety and multi-core parallelism, runs on desktop, Android and OpenHarmony, and is governed by Linux Foundation Europe.

sossoldi.title: Sossoldi
sossoldi.description: Open source Flutter app for personal finance and net worth tracking, built to replace the classic spreadsheet. It handles recurring expenses, multiple accounts, investments and currencies, with statistics and data stored only on the device.

winboat.title: WinBoat
winboat.description: Runs Windows apps on Linux as native windows, with no separate virtual desktop. Windows runs in a Docker or Podman container on QEMU/KVM, setup is guided by the GUI, and the Linux home folder is shared with Windows.
